body:
Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1879.

## Problem

`dev/AGENTS.md` describes `emit_tape_outcome()` (dev-poll, #1399) as appending `numbers.ci_red` from `${PR_WALK_CI_RED:-0}` and `review_rounds` from `${PR_WALK_REVIEW_ROUNDS:-0}`.

That is the dev-agent writer (`close_dev_tape_outcome` in `dev/dev-agent.sh`, #1616). `dev/dev-poll.sh` `emit_tape_outcome()` does not write `ci_red`. Its `review_rounds` is a count of `REQUEST_CHANGES` reviews from one forge call, not `PR_WALK_REVIEW_ROUNDS`.

A reader implementing a probe against that paragraph will look for a field dev-poll outcomes do not have, and will mis-attribute `review_rounds`.

Not introduced by #1879 (that PR only added `bits.ci_first_green` to the same sentence).

---
*Auto-created from AI review*

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `dev/AGENTS.md` no longer attributes `ci_red` / `${PR_WALK_CI_RED:-0}` / `${PR_WALK_REVIEW_ROUNDS:-0}` to `emit_tape_outcome()` (dev-poll).
- [ ] `dev/AGENTS.md` states that dev-poll `emit_tape_outcome()` writes `review_rounds` = REQUEST_CHANGES reviews on the PR from one forge call (not `${PR_WALK_REVIEW_ROUNDS:-0}`) plus `duration_s`, and does not write `ci_red`.
- [ ] `dev/AGENTS.md` attributes `ci_red` = `${PR_WALK_CI_RED:-0}` and `review_rounds` = `${PR_WALK_REVIEW_ROUNDS:-0}` to `close_dev_tape_outcome()` (dev-agent, #1616), not to dev-poll.

## Affected files

- `dev/AGENTS.md`

Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1868.

## Problem

`nomad/jobs/edge.hcl` (header, around line 10) says the vault-action dispatcher polls disinto-ops and dispatches actions via Nomad batch jobs. That is not the live path. `docker/edge/dispatcher.sh` defaults `DISPATCHER_BACKEND` to `docker`, and the edge job never sets it, so vault runners are `docker run` from the caddy task (`entrypoint-edge.sh` starts `dispatcher.sh`). The Nomad `vault-runner` jobspec is not what an action with no `image` field hits.

That mismatch is why #1849's failure lived in `_launch_runner_docker` while `vault-runner.hcl` already defaulted to `disinto/agents:local`. The header is still wrong after #1868, so the next image/dispatch fix can land on the jobspec that production does not use.

`docker/edge/dispatcher.sh` still comments that the nomad backend "lands as a pure addition during migration Step 5" (the backend exists; it is just not selected).

## Expected

The edge job header (and the dispatcher backend comment) should say the live edge uses the docker backend unless `DISPATCHER_BACKEND=nomad` is set, and that `VAULT_RUNNER_IMAGE` is how that path picks `disinto/agents:local`.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl` header states the live edge dispatcher dispatches via the docker backend unless `DISPATCHER_BACKEND=nomad` is set (not "via Nomad batch jobs").
- [ ] The header notes that `VAULT_RUNNER_IMAGE` is how the docker path picks `disinto/agents:local`.
- [ ] `docker/edge/dispatcher.sh`'s backend comment reflects that the nomad backend already exists (it is just not the default).

## Affected files

- `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl`
- `docker/edge/dispatcher.sh`
